text:
sam: Heads-up: ap-south saffron cluster (A10 pool) saw a p99 generation jump ~2x after deploy 2028.3.2 ~10:30UTC. Not in eu-west/h100. Anyone oncall?
ci-bot: Deploy 2028.3.2 (PR #4821) finished at 2028-11-12T10:28:42Z to ap-south saffron.
leila: grabbing flamegraphs now. initial flame shows a lot of time in kernel_selector::fallback_path on a10. That looks new.
miguel: can you paste flamegraph? also any KV eviction spikes?
leila: https://artifacts.internal/redwood/flame/1876543210.svg
leila: ```
summary: top frames: kernel_selector::choose -> generic_attn_kernel -> launch_generic_kernel
``` 
harper: that's suspicious — PR #4821 changed default kernel affinity policy to prefer 'compat' on older cuda drivers which might trigger generic kernels on A10. cc @platform
sam: KV cache evictions also spiked around same time, see logs: `kvcache.evictions_rate=0.18 -> 0.6`
miguel: is it eviction causing more compute (recompute prefixes) or is compute slower because of kernel change?
leila: both. Evictions -> more KV reloads -> longer sequences -> generic kernel has worse throughput for L4 parameterization (A10).
ops: I'm seeing elevated NIC transmit wait on saffron nodes, likely due to larger payloads per request after recompute. `tx_queue_len` up and TX stalls observed.
sam: hypothesis: PR #4821 kernel affinity change caused fallback to generic kernels on A10; combined with KV eviction churn -> bigger token work -> IO bursts -> p99
leila: started a local revert test of PR #4821 on one saffron host, profiling in progress. Will report in ~15m.
ci-bot: Canary rollback initiated on instance saffron-03
harper: for mitigation, can we pin kernel policy to 'optimized' for A10 pools via runtime flag? That could be a quick rollout. :hammer:
leila: tried that, it drops p99 back to baseline in dev. Patch: `--kernel-affinity=optimized`
miguel: file a rollback + hotfix PR to override policy for ap-south A10 and add e2e perf test to CI.
sam: created issue #1298 and draft hotfix PR #4899. Adding perf artifacts and flamegraphs.
harper: great. after hotfix we should add a test to detect kernel degenerations and KV eviction correlations.
leila: adding a rule: if kvcache.evictions_rate > 0.3 && kernel == generic then fail perf-ci.
sam: thanks. pinging @infra to schedule a capacity quieting window to reduce noisy neighbors while we roll.
ops: noted. quiet window scheduled for 11:00-11:30 UTC. :white_check_mark:
